Name: Ehud, Son of Gera
Summary: Ehud, a left-handed Benjamite, son of Gera, delivered Israel from Eglon, king of Moab, by killing him with a dagger in his private chamber and leading Israel to retake the fords of Jordan.
KeyStory: Ehud hid a dagger on his right thigh, killed Eglon alone in his summer parlour, escaped, and led Israel to seize the fords of Jordan and strike down Moab.
RelatedPeople: Gera, Father of Ehud; Eglon, King of Moab
LifeLesson: God used an overlooked trait — left-handedness — to undo a king's guard.
